output.notes: The headline model is OPT-175B. All nine sizes in Table model_sizes are listed (the text says 'eight'), and 125M is the primary config. The paper states only the layer count, head count, d_model, ReLU activation, the 2048 sequence length and the GPT-2 BPE tokenizer (vocab size not given). It says the models 'largely follow' GPT-3, but because the inheritance is hedged and GPT-3 includes components OPT may not share (e.g. sparse attention layers), no values were marked inherited. Norm type and placement, positional scheme, d_ff, biases, tying and head_dim are all not_stated, which is why the block has no norm or positional ops. 'All bias terms are initialized as 0' implies that biases exist, but not which layers have them. The paper defers to the metaseq code for unstated details.
